biological_replicate: nine anatomically distinct sections from three aged individuals
experimental_design: multiregional proteomic atlas of 9 brain sections across 3 individuals with varying Alzheimer's disease progression
nine anatomically distinct sections from three aged individuals, across a spectrum of disease progression, categorized by quantity of neurofibrillary tangles
factor_value: brain region (AMY, CNC, CBM, ECX, IPL, MFG, STG, THA, VCX), disease progression (tangle density)

This procedure was performed on all nine sections: Amygdala (AMY), Caudate Nucleus (CNC), Cerebellum (CBM), Entorhinal Cortex (ECX), Inferior Parietal Lobule (IPL), Middle Frontal Gyrus (MFG), Superior Temporal Gyrus (STG), Thalamus (THA), and Visual Cortex (VCX)
number_of_fractions: each sample input as an experiment made up of 12 fractions
